scripts.build:css: npx tailwindcss -i assets/css/tailwind-input.css -o assets/css/tailwind.min.css --minify && npx esbuild assets/css/style.css --minify --outfile=assets/css/style.min.css && npx esbuild assets/css/service-editorial.css --minify --outfile=assets/css/service-editorial.min.css
scripts.build:js: npx esbuild assets/js/main.js --minify --outfile=assets/js/main.min.js && npx esbuild assets/js/service-editorial.js --minify --outfile=assets/js/service-editorial.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:inline && npm run build:js
